title: Ladies Day 2021
subtitle: Southwest Division Ladies Day events of 2021, club by club.

sections.heading: Ladies Day at Newport Harbor Lawn Bowling Club - September 15, 2021
body: Ladies Day was held at Newport Harbor LBC . It was wonderful to have so many ladies join us for their first time.  From Hermosa Beach; Gale Gellerman and Tricia Quan.  From Holmby; Claudia Sego and Holly Gross.  From Laguna Beach; Catherine Major, Jackie Kelly.  From Long Beach; Connie Delgado, June/Kiwi, Margaret Butler, Paulina Wong, Ramona Loucks.  From Newport Harbor; Beth Bianchi, Dawn Hayes, Joan Robbins.  We hope to continue having newcomers to experience the fun.

Thank you to the clubs who promoted this Ladies Day.  We were represented by Costa del Sol, Hermosa Beach LBC, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, Santa Ana LBC and The Groves LBC.

This was a terrific start to resuming Ladies Day.  Newport Harbor had a lovely display of breakfast and lunch items and topped it off with ice cream.  Thanks to everyone who helped us make this a very special day.
In the morning 12 ends were played  and the winners were:
1st Place:        Candy Defazio           Charlyn Moltane            Ramona Loucks
2nd Place:       Sheila Conti               Jane Blair                      Catherine Major
3rd Place          Diana Wenzel           Eleanor Reafsnyder       June/Kiwi
4th Place tie:    Susan Denton           Val Blackholly                Gale Gellerman
4th Place tie    Debby Gaal               Joan Robbins
The afternoon game of 10 ends and the winners were:
1st Place:           Sheila Conti                     Sally Cadwallader      Janice Walter
2nd Place:         Sandra Mironesco            Val Blackholly            Gale Gellerman
3rd Place:           Mary Spease                    Karen Billon
Congratulations to all the winners. The next Ladies Day is Long Beach LBC on October 13, 2021.
Thank you to all the Ladies who participated in this Ladies Day.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel
Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: October 13 - Ladies Day at Long Beach Lawn Bowling Club
body: Ladies Day was held at Long Beach LBC . I love when we have ladies join us for their first time. This time we had Keetje Berndt from Holmby LBC, Kathi Becker from Long Beach LBC and Janell Williams from Santa Ana LBC.  I hope we continue growing.  It is a wonderful experience to bowl with Ladies from the various clubs.
Thank you to the clubs who promoted this Ladies Day.  We were represented by Casta Del Sol LBC, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, Santa Ana LBC and Santa Anita.

A big thank you to the members of Long Beach LBC for making this a fun Ladies Day.  We had breakfast items and terrific a great variety of food for lunch. Thanks to everyone who helped us make this a very special day.

We had a very special guest come to watch our games, Joline Beck.  Joline just returned from the Senior Games in Utah and it was such a pleasure to see her again – she has been bowling for over 35 years.
In the morning 12 ends were played  and the winners were:
1st Place:        Linda Bator                Cynthia Nolan                   Margaret Butler
2nd Place:       Mary Spease             Claudia Sego                     Trish Soto
3rd Place:        Sheila Conti               Eleanor Reafsnyder        Carol Petyo
The afternoon game of 10 ends and the winners were:
1st Place:        Mary Spease            Cynthia Nolan                     Molly Smulian
2nd Place       Diana Wenzel           Trish Soto                           Keetje Berndt
3rd Plac           Margi Rambo            Claudia Sego                      Eleanor Reafsnyder
Congratulations to all the winners. The next Ladies Day is Laguna Beach LBC on November 10, 2021.
Thank you to all the Ladies who participated in this Ladies Day.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel
Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: November 10, 2021 Ladies Day at Laguna Beach LBC
body: Ladies Day was held at the Laguna Beach LBC.  We had a great turnout with 34 ladies.  A big thank you to the hospitality of Laguna Beach with breakfast items, lovely lunch salads and goodies, we even had Heather Stewart’s heavenly hash cookies – YUM.  The day couldn’t have been more perfect with beautiful weather and wonderful surroundings along with great lady bowlers.  The clubs joining us for the day were Casta del Sol, Holmby LBC,  Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, The Groves and Santa Ana LBC.

We were delighted to have the following Ladies attend Ladies’ Day for the First time.  Julie Kimura, Andra Minnehan, Karen Sando and Sally Vogel.  Each time we have new participants and it is so fabulous to see more experiencing this special day.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played  and the winners were:
1st Place:           Linda Roberts                Sandy Graham              Karen Sando
2nd Place:          Joanne Hedgespeth       Eileen Lazar
3rd Place:         Diana Wenzel               Eleanor Reafsnyer         Carol Petyo
4th Place:          Mary Thompson            Linda Bator
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place:           Heather Stewart           Phyllis Turner                Carol Petyo
2nd Place:          Julie Buchanan              Roni Witherbee            Jujlie Kimura
3rd Place:            Shelley Cohen              Eileen Lazar                  Holly Gross
Congratulations to all the winners.

Our next Ladies Day will be our Holiday Luncheon and one game of lawn bowling.  Anyone can choose to bowl and have lunch or simply show up for the luncheon.  Please check for the signup sheets and payment information which will be posted at your club.
Laguna Woods on Dec 7, 2021.  Please see this is a Tuesday – not our normal Wednesday.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

images.alt: Three bowlers in whites talking on the green at Laguna Beach, the ocean and palm trees behind them.
The Ladies Day group posed in front of the Laguna Beach Lawn Bowling Club sign and clubhouse.

sections.heading: December 7, 2021 Ladies Day Holiday Luncheon, Laguna Woods LBC
body: We ended our lawn bowling year with a bang.  What a fabulous day of bowling and a spectacular luncheon.  Thanks to Sheila Conti for organizing the food and the setting up the room.  A big thank you to everyone who attended and not only dressed for the occasion with their holiday spirit, but for being such a wonderful group.  We filled the room with happy faces, entertainment, good food, wine (donated by Laguna Woods LBC), and had so much fun picking our raffle prizes.  Charlyn Moltane sang a very funny lawn bowling song and amused us all.  Many were in the spirit and danced at their table.
Here are the winners of our lawn bowling game:
1st Place:           Heather Stewart           Jackie Proctor               Le Anderson
2nd Place:          Lee Ang                        Tina Larson                   Andra Minnehan
3rd Place:         Georgie Deno               Joanne Steckler             Julie Kimura
Congratulations to all the winners.
This was our last game of the year but hopefully we will begin again March 2022 and look forward to seeing everyone on the green.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators
